title: Heavenly Delusion
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Fifteen years after a disaster wrecked Japan, the boy Maru and his bodyguard Kiruko cross the ruins searching for 'Heaven' and fighting thieves and man-eating creatures. Meanwhile, gifted children live sealed inside a facility their caretakers call Heaven, told the outside is Hell. The two stories slowly converge, revealing experiments on children and the fact that Kiruko is a young man's brain in his sister's body.
life_message: It holds up loyalty and love that see past bodies and labels, and the search for truth over comforting lies.
